1. ALL CONSTRUCTION SHALL CONFORM TO THE AMERICANS WITH DISABILITIES ACT ACCESSIBILITY
GUIDELINES (ADAAG), LOCAL GOVERNING FIRE, SAFETY, AND BUILDING CODES, REQUIREMENTS
AND REGULATIONS, 2024 IBC, ANSI A117.1 -2009.
2. ALL DIMENSIONS ARE TO THE FACE OF CONCRETE OR MASONRY, FACE OF STUD WALLS, OR
CENTERLINE OF COLUMNS UNLESS NOTED OTHERWISE.
3. ASBESTOS OR ASBESTOS CONTAINING PRODUCTS ARE NOT ALLOWED IN ANY ASPECT OF THIS
CONSTRUCTION.
4. COORDINATE ALL DISCIPLINES AND ALL ASPECTS OF WORK. CONFLICTS AND DISCREPANCIES
SHALL BE BROUGHT TO THE ATTENTION OF THE ARCHITECT IMMEDIATELY.
5. MINIMUM ROOF R VALUE = R30 (R20ci) -MINIMUM WALL R VALUE = R7.6ci
6. ALL FINISH ELEVATIONS ARE TO TOP OF WALKS, GRADE, PAVING, WALLS, ROOFS, ETC., UNLESS
NOTED OTHERWISE
7. ALL SOIL BERMS SHALL BE CONSTRUCTED TO DRAIN AWAY FROM VERTICAL SURFACES
8. ALL GROUND PREPARATION SHALL BE IN CONFORMANCE WITH THE RECOMMENDATIONS OF THE
GEOTECHNICAL REPORT. THE CONTRACTOR SHALL BE RESPONSIBLE TO OBTAIN A COPY OF THIS
REPORT. ALL RECOMMENDATIONS AND REQUIREMENTS CONTAINED WITHIN THE SOILS REPORT
ARE TO BE FOLLOWED UNLESS SPECIFICALLY NOTED OTHERWISE IN THE DRAWINGS OR
TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS
9. ALL CONCRETE SURFACES WHICH RECEIVE A SPECIAL FINISH, FLOOR COVERING, COATINGS,
HARDENERS, ETC. SHALL BE CONSTRUCTED IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE SPECIFIC FINISH
MANUFACTURER'S SPECIFICATIONS AND INSTRUCTIONS. PRIOR TO APPLICATION OF A SPECIAL
FINISH, A WRITTEN ACCEPTANCE OF THE SURFACE SHALL BE SUBMITTED TO THE ARCHITECT BY
THE GENERAL CONTRACTOR
10. ALL CONCRETE WALKS, STEPS, CURBS AND EQUIPMENT PADS SHALL HAVE A MEDIUM BROOM
FINISH UNLESS NOTED OTHERWISE
11. ALL EXTERIOR CONCRETE APRONS SHALL HAVE A HEAVY BROOM FINISH
12. SLOPE ALL CONCRETE SURFACES ADJACENT TO THE BUILDING AWAY FROM THE BUILDING
13. SAW CUTS IN LIEU OF CONTROL JOINTS ARE NOT ALLOWED IN CONCRETE SIDEWALKS
14. ALL CONCRETE SURFACES UPON WHICH PEDESTRIANS CAN WALK SHALL BE FINISHED SUCH
THAT THE MINIMUM STATIC COEFFICIENT OF SLIDING FRICTION BETWEEN THE SURFACE AND
NORMAL HARD-SOLED SHOES = 0.60 AND 0.80 FOR RAMPS
15. ALL CONCRETE AND MASONRY CONNECTIONS AND JOINTS SHALL BE COMPLETELY SEALED AND
WATERPROOFED WITH BACKER ROD AND SEALANT AS RECOMMENDED AND SPECIFIED BY EACH
SPECIFIC APPLICATION
16. ALL CONCRETE FLOORS SHALL BE COMPLETELY CAULKED AND SEALED
17. CONDUCT WATER TEST TO INSURE WATERTIGHT PERFORMANCE OF ALL ROOFING SYSTEMS AND
COMPONENTS, INCLUDING ADJACENT WINDOWS, WALLS, UNITS, PENETRATIONS, ECT. REFER TO
ROOFING SPECIFICATIONS FOR REQUIRED PROCEDURES
18. CONTRACTOR SHALL COORDINATE ALL CONCRETE SLABS TO SLOPE AWAY FROM BUILDING, TO
SLOPE TOWARD DRAINS TO RECESS FOR TILE APPLICATIONS, ETC., IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE
ARCHITECTURAL AND STRUCTURAL DRAWINGS
19. ALL CONCRETE BLOCK SURFACES ADJACENT TO SOIL BERMS AND PLANTERS SHALL BE
PROVIDED WITH A MONOLITHIC WATERPROOF SYSTEM EXTENDING FROM BOTTOM OF FOOTING
TO 4"ABOVE SOIL
20. ALL PLANTER AND RETAINING WALLS SHALL BE CONSTRUCTED WITH 3/4" DIAMETER PVC WEEP
HOLES AT 6'-0" O.C. MAXIMUM
21. ALL EXPOSED WELDS SHALL BE GROUND SMOOTH AND FINISHED WITH NO PITS FOR
ARCHITECTURAL APPEARANCE
22. ALL EXPOSED METAL SURFACES THAT ARE NOT PREFINISHED ARE TO BE PAINTED
23. PROVIDE METAL STRAPPING AND ANCHORAGE FOR CEILING AND WALL MOUNTED EQUIPMENT
24. ALL SHEET METAL FLASHINGS ARE TO BE IN ACCORDANCE WITH ARCHITECTURAL SHEET METAL
MANUAL AS PRODUCED BY SHEET METAL AND AIR CONDITIONING CONTRACTORS NATIONAL
ASSOCIATION (SMACNA)
25. PROVIDE SEPARATION AND/OR APPROPRIATE COATING BETWEEN ALL DISSIMILAR METALS. ALL
TRANSITIONS BETWEEN SIMILAR OR DISSIMILAR MATERIALS, EQUIPMENT, ACCESSORIES, ETC.
SHALL BE CAULKED AND/OR SEALED AS REQUIRED
26. METAL STUD PARTITIONS SHALL TERMINATE 6" ABOVE THE CEILING LINE AND BE BRACED AT 48"
O.C. WITH DIAGONAL BRACING TO THE STRUCTURE, UNLESS NOTED OTHERWISE. SEE PARTITION
TYPES AND PLAN. PROVIDE AIR TRANSFER OPENINGS AS REQUIRED BY MECHANICAL
27. ALL TILE GROUT JOINTS SHALL BE SEALED (WATERPROOFED) AND HARDENED, IN STRICT
ACCORDANCE WITH MANUFACTURER RECOMMENDATIONS
28. REMOVABLE STOPS SHALL BE INTERIOR TO THE BUILDING
29. CONTRACTOR SHALL FIELD VERIFY DIMENSIONALLY ALL OPENINGS PRIOR TO MANUFACTURING
WINDOW AND DOOR FRAMES
30. ALL DOOR AND FRAME ASSEMBLIES AND INSTALLATIONS SHALL BE IN STRICT ACCORDANCE
WITH UNIFORM LIFE SAFETY CODES GOVERNING EDITION. ALL EXTERIOR DOORS SHALL BE
COMPLETE WITH PROPER THRESHOLDS, ASTRAGALS, WEATHERSTRIPPING, HOLDS AND DOOR
BOTTOMS
31. ALL FIRE EXTINGUISHER LOCATIONS TO BE FINALIZED BY THE STATE FIRE MARSHAL. LOCATIONS
SHOWN ON THE DRAWINGS ARE FOR REFERENCE ONLY
32. COATINGS MUST COMPLY WITH ALL LOCAL AND FEDERAL LAWS GOVERNING VOLATILE ORGANIC
COMPOUNDS, AND ALL ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION AGENCY RECOMMENDATIONS
33. CONTRACTOR SHALL NOT SCALE ANY DRAWING IN THIS BID SET
34. THE AUTOMATIC FIRE SPRINKLER DRAWINGS, THE HYDRAULIC CALCULATIONS AND THE
MATERIAL SPECIFICATIONS SHALL BE SUBMITTED TO THE STATE OF NEVADA, OFFICE OF THE
STATE FIRE MARSHAL BY A LICENSED FIRE SPRINKLER CONTRACTOR FOR REVIEW PRIOR TO
INSTALLATION
35. THE FIRE ALARM DRAWINGS AND MATERIAL SPECIFICATIONS SHALL BE SUBMITTED TO THE
STATE OF NEVADA OFFICE OF THE STATE FIRE MARSHAL BY A LICENSED CONTRACTOR FOR
REVIEW PRIOR TO INSTALLATION. "...THESE DEFERRED SUBMITTAL ITEMS SHALL BE SUBMITTED
TO THE REGISTERED DESIGN PROFESSIONAL IN RESPONSIBLE CHARGE WHO SHALL REVIEW
THEM AND FORWARD THEM TO THE BUILDING OFFICIAL WITH A NOTATION INDICATING THAT THE
DEFERRED SUBMITTAL DOCUMENTS HAVE BEEN REVIEWED AND THAT THEY HAVE BEEN FOUND
TO BE IN GENERAL CONFORMANCE WITH THE DESIGN OF THE BUILDING. THE DEFERRED
SUBMITTAL ITEMS SHALL NOT BE INSTALLED UNTIL THEIR DESIGN AND SUBMITTAL DOCUMENTS
HAVE BEEN APPROVED BY THE BUILDING OFFICIAL..." SEE MECHANICAL, ELECTRICAL, PLUMBING
AND STRUCTURAL FOR ADDITIONAL DEFERRED SUBMITTAL REQUIREMENTS
36. CONTRACTOR IS RESPONSIBLE FOR COORDINATING THE LOCATION OF THE ACCESS DOORS FOR
PLUMBING VALVES, CLEAN OUTS, WATER HAMMER ARRESTORS ETC. TO ENSURE
SERVICEABILITY OF THE EQUIPMENT. ALL ACCESS DOORS LOCATED ON WALLS SHALL BE
PAINTED TO MATCH WALL. ALL ACCESS PANELS LOCATED IN CEILINGS SHALL BE PAINTED TO
MATCH CEILING. ALL ACCESS DOORS EASILY ACCESSIBLE TO THE PUBLIC SHALL BE LOCKABLE.
PROVIDE A CYLINDER LOCK WITH LATCH AND TWO KEYS FOR EACH DOOR
37. REFER TO SHEET G111 AND G112 AT ALL HANDICAP AREAS, EXCEPT FOR WHERE DIMENSIONED
OR NOTED OTHERWISE WITHIN THESE DOCUMENTS
38. INSPECT EXISTING ADJACENT PROPERTIES AND STRUCTURES. TAKE EXTRA CARE TO PROTECT
THEM WHEN WORKING NEARBY. DO NOT PROCEED UNTIL OTHER PROPERTY IS PROTECTED AND
SECURED
39. PROVIDE SHORING AS REQUIRED. DO NOT CONSTRUE THE BID DOCUMENTS AS LIMITING THE
MEANS AND METHODS NECESSARY TO PROTECT EXISTING STRUCTURES. THE DRAWINGS DO
NOT INCLUDE SHORING DESIGN OR PROTECTION OF ADJACENT PROPERTIES, AND WILL NOT
INDICATE WHERE SHORING OR PROTECTION IS NECESSARY
40. ALL NOTES, DETAILS, SPECIFICATIONS, AND OTHER PROVISIONS INCLUDED IN THESE CONTRACT
DOCUMENTS, WHETHER CROSS REFERENCE OR NOT, ARE PART OF THIS PROJECT. ALL WORK
SHOWN HEREIN SHALL BE PERFORMED WITHOUT EXCEPTION

1. ALL CONSTRUCTION SHALL CONFORM TO THE AMERICANS WITH DISABILITIES ACT ACCESSIBILITY
GUIDELINES (ADAAG), LOCAL GOVERNING FIRE, SAFETY, AND BUILDING CODES, REQUIREMENTS
AND REGULATIONS, 2024 IBC, ANSI A117.1 -2009.
2. ALL DIMENSIONS ARE TO THE FACE OF CONCRETE OR MASONRY, FACE OF STUD WALLS, OR
CENTERLINE OF COLUMNS UNLESS NOTED OTHERWISE.
3. ASBESTOS OR ASBESTOS CONTAINING PRODUCTS ARE NOT ALLOWED IN ANY ASPECT OF THIS
CONSTRUCTION.
4. COORDINATE ALL DISCIPLINES AND ALL ASPECTS OF WORK. CONFLICTS AND DISCREPANCIES
SHALL BE BROUGHT TO THE ATTENTION OF THE ARCHITECT IMMEDIATELY.
5. MINIMUM ROOF R VALUE = R30 (R20ci) -MINIMUM WALL R VALUE = R7.6ci
6. ALL FINISH ELEVATIONS ARE TO TOP OF WALKS, GRADE, PAVING, WALLS, ROOFS, ETC., UNLESS
NOTED OTHERWISE
7. ALL CONCRETE AND MASONRY CONNECTIONS AND JOINTS SHALL BE COMPLETELY SEALED AND
WATERPROOFED WITH BACKER ROD AND SEALANT AS RECOMMENDED AND SPECIFIED BY EACH
SPECIFIC APPLICATION
8. ALL CONCRETE FLOORS SHALL BE COMPLETELY CAULKED AND SEALED
9. CONDUCT WATER TEST TO INSURE WATERTIGHT PERFORMANCE OF ALL ROOFING SYSTEMS AND
COMPONENTS, INCLUDING ADJACENT WINDOWS, WALLS, UNITS, PENETRATIONS, ECT. REFER TO
ROOFING SPECIFICATIONS FOR REQUIRED PROCEDURES
10. CONTRACTOR SHALL COORDINATE ALL CONCRETE SLABS TO SLOPE AWAY FROM BUILDING, TO
SLOPE TOWARD DRAINS TO RECESS FOR TILE APPLICATIONS, ETC., IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE
ARCHITECTURAL AND STRUCTURAL DRAWINGS
11. ALL EXPOSED METAL SURFACES THAT ARE NOT PREFINISHED ARE TO BE PAINTED
12. PROVIDE METAL STRAPPING AND ANCHORAGE FOR CEILING AND WALL MOUNTED EQUIPMENT
13. ALL SHEET METAL FLASHINGS ARE TO BE IN ACCORDANCE WITH ARCHITECTURAL SHEET METAL
MANUAL AS PRODUCED BY SHEET METAL AND AIR CONDITIONING CONTRACTORS NATIONAL
ASSOCIATION (SMACNA)
14. PROVIDE SEPARATION AND/OR APPROPRIATE COATING BETWEEN ALL DISSIMILAR METALS. ALL
TRANSITIONS BETWEEN SIMILAR OR DISSIMILAR MATERIALS, EQUIPMENT, ACCESSORIES, ETC.
SHALL BE CAULKED AND/OR SEALED AS REQUIRED
15. METAL STUD PARTITIONS SHALL TERMINATE 6" ABOVE THE CEILING LINE AND BE BRACED AT 48"
O.C. WITH DIAGONAL BRACING TO THE STRUCTURE, UNLESS NOTED OTHERWISE. SEE PARTITION
TYPES AND PLAN. PROVIDE AIR TRANSFER OPENINGS AS REQUIRED BY MECHANICAL
16. ALL TILE GROUT JOINTS SHALL BE SEALED (WATERPROOFED) AND HARDENED, IN STRICT
ACCORDANCE WITH MANUFACTURER RECOMMENDATIONS
17. REMOVABLE STOPS SHALL BE INTERIOR TO THE BUILDING
18. CONTRACTOR SHALL FIELD VERIFY DIMENSIONALLY ALL OPENINGS PRIOR TO MANUFACTURING
WINDOW AND DOOR FRAMES
19. ALL DOOR AND FRAME ASSEMBLIES AND INSTALLATIONS SHALL BE IN STRICT ACCORDANCE
WITH UNIFORM LIFE SAFETY CODES GOVERNING EDITION. ALL EXTERIOR DOORS SHALL BE
COMPLETE WITH PROPER THRESHOLDS, ASTRAGALS, WEATHERSTRIPPING, HOLDS AND DOOR
BOTTOMS
20. ALL FIRE EXTINGUISHER LOCATIONS TO BE FINALIZED BY THE STATE FIRE MARSHAL. LOCATIONS
SHOWN ON THE DRAWINGS ARE FOR REFERENCE ONLY
21. COATINGS MUST COMPLY WITH ALL LOCAL AND FEDERAL LAWS GOVERNING VOLATILE ORGANIC
COMPOUNDS, AND ALL ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION AGENCY RECOMMENDATIONS
22. CONTRACTOR SHALL NOT SCALE ANY DRAWING IN THIS BID SET
23. THE AUTOMATIC FIRE SPRINKLER DRAWINGS, THE HYDRAULIC CALCULATIONS AND THE
MATERIAL SPECIFICATIONS SHALL BE SUBMITTED TO THE STATE OF NEVADA, OFFICE OF THE
STATE FIRE MARSHAL BY A LICENSED FIRE SPRINKLER CONTRACTOR FOR REVIEW PRIOR TO
INSTALLATION
24. THE FIRE ALARM DRAWINGS AND MATERIAL SPECIFICATIONS SHALL BE SUBMITTED TO THE
STATE OF NEVADA OFFICE OF THE STATE FIRE MARSHAL BY A LICENSED CONTRACTOR FOR
REVIEW PRIOR TO INSTALLATION. "...THESE DEFERRED SUBMITTAL ITEMS SHALL BE SUBMITTED
TO THE REGISTERED DESIGN PROFESSIONAL IN RESPONSIBLE CHARGE WHO SHALL REVIEW
THEM AND FORWARD THEM TO THE BUILDING OFFICIAL WITH A NOTATION INDICATING THAT THE
DEFERRED SUBMITTAL DOCUMENTS HAVE BEEN REVIEWED AND THAT THEY HAVE BEEN FOUND
TO BE IN GENERAL CONFORMANCE WITH THE DESIGN OF THE BUILDING. THE DEFERRED
SUBMITTAL ITEMS SHALL NOT BE INSTALLED UNTIL THEIR DESIGN AND SUBMITTAL DOCUMENTS
HAVE BEEN APPROVED BY THE BUILDING OFFICIAL..." SEE MECHANICAL, ELECTRICAL, PLUMBING
AND STRUCTURAL FOR ADDITIONAL DEFERRED SUBMITTAL REQUIREMENTS
25. CONTRACTOR IS RESPONSIBLE FOR COORDINATING THE LOCATION OF THE ACCESS DOORS FOR
PLUMBING VALVES, CLEAN OUTS, WATER HAMMER ARRESTORS ETC. TO ENSURE
SERVICEABILITY OF THE EQUIPMENT. ALL ACCESS DOORS LOCATED ON WALLS SHALL BE
PAINTED TO MATCH WALL. ALL ACCESS PANELS LOCATED IN CEILINGS SHALL BE PAINTED TO
MATCH CEILING. ALL ACCESS DOORS EASILY ACCESSIBLE TO THE PUBLIC SHALL BE LOCKABLE.
PROVIDE A CYLINDER LOCK WITH LATCH AND TWO KEYS FOR EACH DOOR
26. REFER TO SHEET G1.00 AT ALL HANDICAP AREAS, EXCEPT FOR WHERE DIMENSIONED OR NOTED
OTHERWISE WITHIN THESE DOCUMENTS
27. INSPECT EXISTING ADJACENT PROPERTIES AND STRUCTURES. TAKE EXTRA CARE TO PROTECT
THEM WHEN WORKING NEARBY. DO NOT PROCEED UNTIL OTHER PROPERTY IS PROTECTED AND
SECURED
28. PROVIDE SHORING AS REQUIRED. DO NOT CONSTRUE THE BID DOCUMENTS AS LIMITING THE
MEANS AND METHODS NECESSARY TO PROTECT EXISTING STRUCTURES. THE DRAWINGS DO
NOT INCLUDE SHORING DESIGN OR PROTECTION OF ADJACENT PROPERTIES, AND WILL NOT
INDICATE WHERE SHORING OR PROTECTION IS NECESSARY
29. ALL NOTES, DETAILS, SPECIFICATIONS, AND OTHER PROVISIONS INCLUDED IN THESE CONTRACT
DOCUMENTS, WHETHER CROSS REFERENCE OR NOT, ARE PART OF THIS PROJECT. ALL WORK
SHOWN HEREIN SHALL BE PERFORMED WITHOUT EXCEPTION
30. ALL UNIVERSITY OF NEVADA FIRE EXTINGUISHERS SHALL BE AMEREX BRAND
31. ALL CO2 TYPE EXTINGUISHERS SHALL BE NO LARGER THAN 10 LBS, UNLESS SPECIFICALLY
CALLED FOR AND APPROVED BY FSD
